production_environment: Render (render.yaml); deploys from the integration branch (from CLAUDE.md)
development_environment: local / cloud session; branch claude/* (no CI on session branches)
release_restrictions: HOLD (CLAUDE.md rule 2): no PR, no push to a remote, no deploy unless Livio writes the exact words 'ship it'; until then commit locally only
HOLD: warn Livio before any action that spends GitHub Actions minutes or Render compute
HOLD: run `npm run verify` before every push; never push red or unrun
Safety layer (policy engine, allowlist, kill switch, audit trail) can never be bypassed
data_sensitivity: Scan targets are Livio's own assets; keep findings only, never the data read from a target
required_tests: npm run verify before every push
deployment_process: Render deploys after CI passes on the push to integration; sessions never deploy without the word 'ship it'
rollback_process: UNVERIFIED: Render redeploy of previous commit; confirm and document
critical_workflows: policy engine approval before any scan
